text:
ria: re: last month's db fail, we need a tighter postmortem follow-up flow so actions don't linger. small proposal below.
sam: yesss. the old 'owners please update' never worked.
ria: proposal (minimal):
```
T0: PM posts postmortem + list actions with provisional owners
T+48h: owners confirm or reassign + provide ETA (required)
Weekly x6: 15m async update (tracker row updated)
T+30d: SRE verifies monitoring + smoke test
T+60d: final regression check and close
```
jess: suggest we require a single remediation owner per action (no teams). ownership transfers must be logged in tracker.
kai: agree. i'll volunteer to run a 6-week IC rotation pilot and take IC onboarding notes.
incident-bot: Reminder set: "pm-followup: db-fail-2026" in 48 hours for @ria
ria: immediate tasks: 1) create tracker template (jess) due tomorrow EOD; 2) add timeline snippet to runbook (sam) due Wed; 3) start IC pilot roster (kai) due next Mon.
sam: i'll PR the runbook snippet after jess posts the tracker link. low ceremony = better adoption.
jess: will post sheet + one-line copy/paste row for postmortems in #eng-oncall shortly.
kai: will post rotation sign-up and ping for volunteers.
ria: ok locking this in. owners please update before the 1st weekly check.
